newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cognex rating lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cognex rating lowered.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co LLC equity analyst Mark Langley said Monday he had lowered his rating on Cognex Corp to outperform from strong buy, based on price appreciation, but he raised his quarterly and annual earnings estimates on the company.
-- Langley said in a research note he had raised his 1997 estimate to $0.79 per share from $0.78, and his 1998 estimate to $1.07 from $1.01.
-- He moved his price target up to $30 per share from $27.

-- Gruntal said it raised estimates on Cognex because of improving earnings visibility, an ongoing recovery in the semiconductor and electronics markets, expanding margins driven by increasing revenues, and new products.

-- Cognex has ramped up its sales force to keep pace with demand and has three new promising products in its pipeline: PatMax, a new method for high-accuracy pattern recognition and defect detection; a digital three-dimensional sensor, and the Cognex 8000 series, the next generation "vision engine," Gruntal said.
-- Langley said, "We believe the improved business environment for Cognex is already reflected in the recent price strength of the stock."
-- Cognex was off 7/8 at 24-1/2 early Monday.
